aiVerification.summary: Comparable evidence exists, but the draft misgroups the changed factor and pairs later tests with the wrong normal rows.
issues: Primary factor should be VP not spread sample vs normal lot, not line TIU C11-20 R.
Rows 19 and 23 are incorrectly compared to row 17 instead of their adjacent normal rows.
Comparison rows omit normal evidence rows 21 and 25.
Measurement outcome appears to be defect-category breakdown, not a separate measurement domain.
Evidence cites Test!14, which is not supported by the supplied context.
correctionPlan: Set baselineCondition to Normal lot and changedCondition to Test VP not spread sample.
Keep TIU C11-20 R and date as subgroup context.
Pair Test!15 with Test!17, Test!19 with Test!21, and Test!23 with Test!25.
Recalculate deltas using each matched normal row.
Remove the separate measurement outcome or convert it to defect-category details with valid row citations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are not sufficient until valid paired rows and header/context rows are used; avoid unsupported Test!14.
